name: zamrud-play
description: Zamrud Play — platform hiburan simulasi bergaya kasino dengan koin virtual gratis.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run i18n:check && npm test && npm run build
